reason: The production UPF Engineering PDI source repeatedly returned HTTP 403 from GitHub Actions and was a weak domain fit. The official UPF MELIS job board publishes biomedical, neuroscience-adjacent, physiology-related, technician, postdoctoral, and research positions and is a materially better source target for this job-search profile.

replacement_scope.new_board: UPF Faculty of Medicine and Life Sciences (MELIS) Job Offers
replacement_scope.coverage_scope: newest year section on the official MELIS job board

collector_guards: publication date is not treated as application deadline
official vacancy/call documents are preferred for Full JD
admitted/excluded lists, award proposals, results and later process documents are never used as Full JD
later-stage process paperwork can mark a listing CLOSED
no relevance filtering is performed before the frozen scorer
